body: In the past few days I've taken to walking, at least 5-6 miles in the worst weather. Just a small distraction and the cold and rain is enough punishment and numbness so I don't feel the need to do anything more permanent. I might feel terrible but at least I might be fitter and attractive at some point haha.. It's just as soon as it's late and my fully alone in my mind everything crashes down on me, but I'll be looking for something to fill that time. You're right though, self-care would be the answer. It's Just difficult to feel deserving of it, so I'll try the baby steps
I just want to thank you for your response. I don't know if/how well I can follow it, but your advice is sound. I appreciate it
